results.title: Area Codes
results.overview: A girl from Stockton, Gabriella, breaks up with her long-term boyfriend and decides to help her best friend move to Los Angeles as a short getaway. At the biggest night market in LA, she meets a boy who was born and raised in SoCal, Jayson, and he shows her iconic and sentimental places within every area code of the greater LA area.

results.title: Amped
results.overview: A dysfunctional and toxic rock band is barely being held together by their stressed-out manager. With one last concert to impress a record label and get signed, the band's future hangs in the balance as tensions threaten to tear them apart.

results.title: Soundtrack to a Coup d’Etat 2
results.overview: A documentary about Thai political conflicts and the Thai monarch's brilliance in jazz music.

results.title: An Abandoned World
results.overview: After the father's disappearance, a mother and her son take refuge in an isolated house between the mountain and the lake. In confinement, time seems suspended as they await an impossible return. Amid silence and memories, grief unfolds in its many layers, transforming the pain of absence into an intimate experience of the bittersweet, melancholy process of saying goodbye.

results.title: Father Father
results.overview: Khader and Aviv, a Muslim-Jewish gay couple, dream of starting a family. Yet, amid the joy of pregnancy and the rise of far-right extremism and war propaganda, they are forced to confront a difficult question: What does it mean to bring a child into a world torn by conflict?

results.title: Don’t Pick Up
results.overview: Tye, a young aspiring junior attorney working on behalf of a Texas oil company, is tasked with falsifying documents connected to a wrongful death lawsuit. However, Tye quickly learns the victim, a worker who drowned in crude oil, haunts the case and now him.

results.title: Kāalgaon
results.overview: In a remote Indian village where women vanish without a trace, a journalist’s investigation awakens a supernatural presence buried beneath generations of silence. As the victims’ voices rise through her, so does a force of karmic vengeance.

results.title: The Gloria! Project
results.overview: A short documentary exploring the life and legacy of queer Latinx civil rights leader Gloria Casarez. Produced over the course of a decade, the film traces Gloria’s journey from her childhood in “the Badlands" of Philadelphia, to grassroots organizer in the anti-poverty and HIV/AIDS movements, to her historic appointment as the city’s first Director of LGBT Affairs. Told through a rich blend of personal archives and voices from her community, the film captures how Gloria’s "boots on the ground" philosophy broke down barriers to ensure everyone had a seat at the table and how her legacy serves as a blueprint to continue the fight against the erasure of marginalized communities.

results.title: Gloria
results.overview: A short film that captures a life-changing dilemma for a Mexican-American bride standing on the brink of traditional expectations. As Gloria prepares to marry her fiancé, Rodrigo, she is consumed by her secret, forbidden love for Emilia—a graceful, queer white woman who refuses to remain hidden in the shadows of heteronormativity. Through flashbacks to the night before the wedding, the film reveals the intense passion and friction between the two women. After an ultimatum from Emilia and a tense discovery by Gloria's sister, Sophia, the reality of their secret shatters the veil of the wedding festivities. Back in the present, Gloria faces a stark ultimatum: if she proceeds with the wedding, Emilia will leave to pursue a life of authenticity and freedom, fleeing the concealment of their relationship. As Rodrigo unknowingly waits at the altar, Gloria is left with the ultimate, breathless choice—honor her cultural tradition, or risk everything to follow a path of true self-discovery.

results.title: Cabin Time
results.overview: In a mountain cabin, a newly sober woman battles loneliness, temptation, and the weight of her past—until an unexpected knock from a neighbor forces her to confront her isolation and discover fragile hope in shared grief and human connection.

results.title: Don't Come Upstairs
results.overview: They were taught one rule: never ask Dad what he does. Don’t Come Upstairs is a documentary that unravels the secret filmmaker Mike Lobel’s father Eric kept hidden—his decades-long role as a prominent drug distributor in Canada. Told through home videos and interviews with family members, this isn’t just about Eric’s double life—it’s about the impact his secrecy had on his family. Exploring generational trauma, the fallout of parental choices, and the hope that comes with facing hard truths in pursuit of healing and connection, Lobel's film builds to a final familial confrontation where one more truth is revealed.

results.title: Sola
results.overview: A young woman who suffers from chronic sleep paralysis awakens to find the world around her has descended into a zombie apocalypse.

results.title: Feed the Dark
results.overview: Snowbound high in the mountains, a ski patroller realizes her injured colleague has been possessed by a ravenous demon.

results.title: What We Carry
results.overview: Stranded in the rural American South, an Ivorian couple must fight to escape an unknown predator.

results.title: Clayhead
results.overview: An aging forensic facial reconstruction artist – tasked with approximating the faces of unidentified remains – creates a model of their own face.

results.title: Upside Down
results.overview: After the loss of his most beloved, Ku the rabbit must face a new reality—literally turned upside down—accompanied by a magical being that will help him navigate his grief and the coldest winter of his life.

results.title: Maia: Threshold of Worlds
results.original_title: Maia: La unión de los mundos
results.overview: In a small city shop, Maia practices the locksmith’s trade in a unique way: aided by an ancient power and a magical door, she can repair keys that hold extraordinary secrets. Accustomed to solving any puzzle with ease, she finds her skills challenged when a mysterious elderly woman hands her a broken key that defies every known technique. Just as she is about to give up, Maia discovers that the object does not respond to conventional methods and that the only way to repair it is to cross into the dimension hidden behind its own door.

results.title: A Truck Full of Kisses
results.overview: Through Graciela’s letters and her children’s replies and drawings, we gain insight into a story shaped by the 1976 dictatorship. Alongside her own account of those years, we adopt a new perspective by learning how the children experienced that era, how they maintained contact with their mother, and the importance the letters held for their family.

results.title: Operation 29
results.overview: In a dystopian reality where homemade food is banned and nutrition comes solely from pills, five older women gather to make gnocchi in absolute secrecy.

results.title: On the Other Side of the Bridge are the Things I Never Said
results.original_title: Del otro lado del puente están las cosas que nunca dije
results.overview: After years apart, Mora reconnects with Luna—the great, unconfessed love of her youth—hoping to rekindle the friendship they once shared. During dinner, Luna reveals she had secretly been in love with her; this long-held silence brings to the surface buried feelings and questions about what might have been.
